UNIVERSITY PROJECTIn development

phisheye.

Suspicious emails. Clearer insights.

Since September 2026

ReactTypeScriptPythonFastAPIPostgreSQL

A web app for structured analysis of suspicious emails. The aim is to bring together findings from headers, metadata and attachments in a shared analysis view for security teams.

Planned features include explainable checks, attachment-hash lookups with VirusTotal and a reasoned assessment of each message. The interface and backend are in development.

UNIVERSITY PROJECT · 2026Co-development · Samurai

Security on a Chip.

IoT security, from device to analysis.

RustLinuxmTLS

A university project for security monitoring of IoT and edge systems. The Rust agent Samurai collects system and security telemetry and sends it to the central Fortress application.

APPLIED RESEARCH 012025

Phishing through business partners

An incident response process

A flexible response framework for phishing from compromised partner accounts, covering detection through documentation. The process supports incident handling while leaving room for professional judgement in each case.

APPLIED RESEARCH 022026

Prioritising vulnerabilities by risk

A prioritisation concept for Microsoft Defender

A developed and evaluated prototype combines exploit availability, estimated exploitation probability and device context. The result is a traceable order for addressing vulnerabilities.
